description: Engineering team from Zakarpattia, Ukraine. Idea: satellite + drone. NASA MODIS/VIIRS (FIRMS) spots a hotspot -> a drone flies from its base to the coordinates, measures CO2, CO, temperature, takes photos -> AI analyzes them and tells: real wildfire, field burning or false alarm, with exact location. Lead: engineer in electronics and ecology. Looking for: Python/AI programmer, drone/GIS enthusiast, designer. Offline at KAI!
